source.title: Forebears South Africa forenames and surnames frequency tables

source.title: ICASA South Africa Numbering Plan Regulations

phones.notes: ICASA governs South Africa numbering resources; national numbers are generated without the domestic trunk 0. Prefixes are mobile-style public allocations and generated numbers are not checked for assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms South Africa uses four-digit postcodes below locality or post office name. City/street pairings and selected prefixes are synthetic review data, not delivery-validated addresses.

identity_number.label: Identity Number

source.title: OECD South Africa TIN information: ID number format

identity_number.notes: OECD confirms the South African ID number is 13 digits and defines YYMMDDSSSSCAZ. This generator intentionally does not implement DOB, gender, citizenship, A digit, or checksum logic, so the rule remains synthetic_pattern.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO South Africa ordinary passport ZAF-AO-02001

passport.notes: PRADO confirms South Africa ordinary passport documents. No public passport-number grammar was confirmed, so the generated format remains an unconfirmed synthetic placeholder.
